descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 在<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【緊急護盾】</>持續時間內，自身可進入<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>臨時損血</>狀態。當臨時損失的生命值回滿時，會生成<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>血箭</>攻擊周圍敵人，並使被<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>血箭</>擊中的敵人受到的傷害提升。<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>血箭</>射出後，<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【緊急護盾】</>效果結束。
descriptionLabels.fr: Tant que le <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Bouclier d'urgence]</> est actif, les PV peuvent être convertis en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>PV récupérables</>. descriptionLabels.zh-Hans: 连招中可按住<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>蓄势，随后发动一套交错切割的快速连斩，将妖气浸入伤口，把敌人身上的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖气侵蚀】</>异化为<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【幽蓝侵蚀】</>，引爆时削减更多杀气。
descriptionLabels.en: During a combo, hold <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> to charge, then unleash a rapid series of crossing slashes that infuse Fiend-Aura into the wounds, transforming <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Fiend-Aura Erosion] </>on the enemy into <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Azure Erosion],</> which depletes more Sha-Chi when it erupts.
descriptionLabels.ja: 連続攻撃中に<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>を長押しで力を溜めると、交差する素早い連続斬撃を繰り出す。さらに、傷口から妖気を浸透させ、敵に付与された<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖気侵蝕】</>を<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【幽藍侵蝕】</>に変化させる。爆発時には、敵の殺気をより多く削る。
descriptionLabels.ko: 연계 공격 중 <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>를 길게 눌러 힘을 모으면, 빠르게 교차하며 적을 연속으로 베어 낸다. 이때 요기를 상처에 침투시켜 적에게 걸린 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>요기 침식</>】을 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>짙푸른 침식</>】으로 변화시킨다. 이를 폭발시키면 적의 살기를 더 많이 감소시킨다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Во время комбо удерживайте<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, чтобы накопить заряд, затем обрушьте стремительную череду перекрёстных ударов, вливая ауру демона в раны. <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Эрозия ауры демона]</> на враге превращается в <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Лазурную эрозию]</> и при взрыве снимает больше Ша-Ци.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 連招中可按住<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>蓄勢，隨後發動一套交錯切割的快速連斬，將妖氣浸入傷口，把敵人身上的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【妖氣侵蝕】</>異化為<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【幽藍侵蝕】</>，引爆時削減更多殺氣。
descriptionLabels.fr: Pendant un combo, maintenez <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> pour charger, puis déchaînez une série rapide de tailles entrecroisées qui imprègnent les plaies d'aura démoniaque, transformant l'<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Érosion démoniaque]</> de l'ennemi en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Érosion azurée],</> laquelle épuise davantage de Sha-Chi lorsqu'elle éclate.
descriptionLabels.de: Halte während einer Kombo <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> zum Aufladen gedrückt und entfessle anschließend eine schnelle Folge sich kreuzender Hiebe. Sie treiben Dämonenaura in die Wunden und verwandeln die <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Dämonenaura-Erosion]</> am Gegner in <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Azur-Erosion]</>, die bei ihrer Eruption mehr Sha-Chi entzieht.
descriptionLabels.es-ES: En un combo, mantén pulsado<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>para cargar y desata una rápida sucesión de cortes entrecruzados que impregna las heridas de aura demoníaca, transformando la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión demoníaca]</> del enemigo en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión azur]</>, que agota más Sha-Chi al detonar.

descriptionLabels.vi: Trong chuỗi liên kích, có thể giữ <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> để tích thế, sau đó tung ra một loạt trảm kích nhanh đan chéo xé nát; Yêu Khí tẩm vào vết thương, biến <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Yêu Khí Xâm Thực]</> trên người kẻ địch thành <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[U Lam Xâm Thực]</>, khi kích nổ sẽ tiêu hao nhiều Sát Khí hơn.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Durante um combo, mantém <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> premido para carregar e, em seguida, desfere rapidamente uma série de golpes cruzados que infundem a Aura Maligna nas feridas, transformando a <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão da Aura Maligna]</> no inimigo em <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão Azul-Celeste]</>, que consome mais Sha-Chi quando entra em erupção.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Durante un combo, Mantén presionado <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para cargar y ejecutar una rápida cadena de cortes cruzados que empapa las heridas con aura demoníaca, transformando la<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </><Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión del aura demoníaca]</><Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </>del enemigo en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión azur]</>, que reduce más Sha-Chi al estallar.

descriptionLabels.th: ระหว่างคอมโบ กด<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>ค้างเพื่อชาร์จพลัง จากนั้นปล่อยชุดฟันปราณสังหารที่กวาดและหมุนอย่างรวดเร็ว ฝังไออสูรเข้าไปถึงไขกระดูก เปลี่ยน<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[ไออสูรกัดกร่อน]</>บนตัวศัตรูเป็น<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[มลทินชาดกัดกร่อน]</> ซึ่งเมื่อปะทุจะสร้างความเสียหายมากขึ้น
descriptionLabels.vi: Trong chuỗi liên kích, có thể giữ <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> để tích thế, sau đó tung ra một loạt trảm kích Sát Khí quét ngang xoáy nhanh; Yêu Khí bị cưa vào tận tủy xương, <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Yêu Khí Xâm Thực]</> trên người kẻ địch biến thành <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Thâm Hồng Xâm Thực]</>, khi kích nổ sẽ gây sát thương lớn hơn.
descriptionLabels.pt-PT: Durante um combo, mantenha <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> premido para carregar e, em seguida, desfira rapidamente uma série de golpes giratórios e amplos de Sha-Chi que fazem a Aura Maligna penetrar profundamente nos ossos, transformando a <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão da Aura Maligna]</> no inimigo em <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosão Carmesim]</>, que causa mais dano quando irrompe.
descriptionLabels.es-419: Durante un combo, Mantén presionado <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> para cargar y luego desata una rápida serie de amplios cortes giratorios de Sha-Chi que infunden aura demoníaca hasta los huesos y transforman la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión del aura demoníaca]</> del enemigo en <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Erosión roja]</>, que inflige más daño al estallar.

descriptionLabels.zh-Hans: 攻击命中敌人时，自身增长<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【血锯】</>计量条，叠满后触发<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【血锯】</>并持续<dtv id="X531"/>秒，期间所有攻击都会使敌人积累<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>流血计量条</>，并会引发<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>大出血</>。对人偶、金身、幻体无效。
descriptionLabels.en: Each hit builds the <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Bloodsaw] </>Gauge. When the gauge is full, <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Bloodsaw] </>activates for <dtv id="X531"/> seconds. While active, all attacks build the enemy's <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Bleed Gauge</> and can trigger <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Blood Loss</>. This effect does not apply to Puppets, Golden Bodies, or Phantom Bodies.
descriptionLabels.ja: 攻撃を敵に当てると自身の<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【血鋸】</>ゲージが溜まり、最大になると<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【血鋸】</>が<dtv id="X531"/>秒間発動する。この間、すべての攻撃が敵の<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>出血ゲージ</>を蓄積させ、<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>大出血</>を引き起こす。人形、金身、幻体には効果がない。
descriptionLabels.ko: 공격이 적에게 적중하면 자신의 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>혈거</>】 게이지가 증가한다. 게이지가 최대치에 도달하면 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>혈거</>】가 발동하며 <dtv id="X531"/>초 동안 지속된다. 지속 시간 동안 모든 공격이 적의 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>출혈 게이지</>를 누적시키며, 일정량 이상 누적되면 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>대출혈</>을 일으킨다. 인형, 금신, 환체에게는 적용되지 않는다.
descriptionLabels.ru: Каждое попадание заполняет шкалу<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Кровавой пилы]</>. При полной шкале<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Кровавая пила]</> активируется на <dtv id="X531"/> секунд. В это время все атаки заполняют <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>шкалу кровотечения</> врага и могут вызвать<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> кровопотерю</>. Не действует на Марионеток, Золотые тела и Фантомные тела.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 攻擊命中敵人時，自身增長<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【血鋸】</>計量條，疊滿後觸發<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【血鋸】</>並持續<dtv id="X531"/>秒，期間所有攻擊都會使敵人積累<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>流血計量條</>，並會引發<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>大出血</>。對人偶、金身和幻體無效。
descriptionLabels.fr: Chaque coup remplit la jauge de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Scie de sang]</>. Tant qu'elle est active, toutes les attaques remplissent la <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>jauge de saignement</> de l'ennemi et peuvent déclencher une <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Hémorragie</>. Cet effet ne s'applique pas aux marionnettes, aux corps d'or ni aux corps spectraux.
descriptionLabels.de: Jeder Treffer füllt die <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Blutsäge]</>-Leiste. Währenddessen bauen alle Angriffe die <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Blutungsleiste</> des Gegners auf und können <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Blutverlust</><Character_Yellow_Decorator2> </>auslösen. descriptionLabels.es-ES: Cada golpe llena el medidor de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Sangrisierra]</>. Mientras está activa, todos los ataques llenan el <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>medidor de sangrado</> del enemigo y pueden provocar <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Pérdida de sangre</>. Este efecto no se aplica a marionetas, cuerpos dorados ni cuerpos espectrales.
descriptionLabels.pt-BR: Cada acerto acrescenta à Barra de <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Serra de Sangue]</>. Enquanto ativa, todos os ataques acrescentam à <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Barra de Sangramento</> e podem ativar <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Hemorragia</>. Esse efeito não se aplica a Marionetes, Corpos Dourados ou Corpos Fantasmas.
descriptionLabels.it: Ogni colpo a segno riempie l'Indicatore della<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Sega di Sangue]</>. descriptionLabels.zh-Hans: 在<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【混沌】</>形态下按住<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>凝神聚气，将场上所有的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>漂浮混沌火焰</>吸收，并斩出强力一击。若吸收的火焰达到<WeaponDes_Num_Green>13</>个，可施展<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【黑火龙卷】</>，持续灼烧身陷其中的敌人。吸收的火焰越多，<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【黑火龙卷】</>的伤害越高，最多可吸收<WeaponDes_Num_Green>60</>个。
descriptionLabels.en: While in <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Chaos]</> form, hold<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>to charge, absorbing all <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Floating Chaotic Flames</> on the field before unleashing a powerful strike. If at least <WeaponDes_Num_Green>13</> flames are absorbed, <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Blackflame Whirlwind]</> can be unleashed to continuously burn enemies caught within. The more flames absorbed, the greater the damage dealt by <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Blackflame Whirlwind]</>. Up to <WeaponDes_Num_Green>60</> flames can be absorbed.
descriptionLabels.ja: <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【混沌】</>形態で<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>を長押しして気を練り、場にあるすべての<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>浮遊する混沌の炎</>を吸収し、強力な一撃を放つ。吸収した炎が<WeaponDes_Num_Green>13</>個に達すると、<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【黒火竜巻】</>を発動し、巻き込まれた敵に継続的な炎ダメージを与える。吸収した炎の数が多いほど<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【黒火竜巻】</>のダメージが増加する。最大<WeaponDes_Num_Green>60</>個まで吸収可能。
descriptionLabels.ko: 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>혼돈</>】 형태에서 <InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>를 길게 누르면 정신을 집중해 기운을 모으고, 전장에 떠다니는 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>혼돈의 화염</>을 모두 흡수하여 강력한 일격을 가한다. 화염을 <WeaponDes_Num_Green>13</>개 이상 흡수하면 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>흑화 회오리</>】를 시전해 그 안에 휘말린 적을 지속적으로 불태운다. 흡수한 화염이 많을수록 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>흑화 회오리</>】의 피해가 증가하며, 최대 <WeaponDes_Num_Green>60</>개까지 흡수할 수 있다.
descriptionLabels.ru: В форме <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Хаос] </>удерживайте<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="0" LeftPadding="5"/>, чтобы зарядить атаку, поглощая всё <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Парящее хаотическое пламя</> на поле боя, а затем нанести мощный удар. Чем больше пламени поглощено, тем выше урон<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Вихря чёрного пламени]</>. Максимум можно поглотить <WeaponDes_Num_Green>60</> единиц.
descriptionLabels.zh-Hant: 在<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【混沌】</>形態下按住<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>凝神聚氣，將場上所有的<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>漂浮混沌火焰</>吸收，並斬出強力一擊。若吸收的火焰達到<WeaponDes_Num_Green>13</>個，可施展<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【黑火龍捲】</>，持續灼燒身陷其中的敵人。吸收的火焰越多，<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【黑火龍捲】</>的傷害越高，最多可吸收<WeaponDes_Num_Green>60</>個。
descriptionLabels.fr: En forme <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Chaos]</>, maintenez<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>pour charger, absorber toutes les<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> Flammes flottantes du chaos</> présentes sur le terrain, puis déclencher une frappe puissante. <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>进入<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布局】</>姿态，在即将受到攻击时施展，可向后<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>遁形闪现</>，并召唤<dtv id="X566"/>把<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【悬浮飞剑】</>进行反击。

若在<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布局】</>姿态下受到攻击，将消耗当前全部杀气，免疫此次伤害并后撤闪避，同时结束<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布局】</>姿态。
<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布局】</>不会打断当前的连招进度。
<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布局】</>姿态下，<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>消耗一定杀气召唤<dtv id="X564"/>把<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>幻化火枪</>攻击敌人，每次<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布局】</>仅可施展一次。
descriptionLabels.en:
Press <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/> to enter<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Grand Design] </>stance. If activated just before an incoming attack, you will <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Teleport </>backward and summon <dtv id="X566"/><Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Floating Swords] </>to counterattack.
Hold <InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> to maintain<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Grand Design]</>. Sha-Chi is gradually consumed while in this stance.  
If attacked while in<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Grand Design] </>stance, all remaining Sha-Chi is consumed to negate the damage and dodge backward, ending <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grand Design]</>.  
<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grand Design] </>does not interrupt your current combo.  
While in <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>[Grand Design] </>stance, press <InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/> to consume a set amount of Sha-Chi and summon <dtv id="X564"/> <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>Phantom Firearms</> to attack enemies. Can only be used once per<Character_Yellow_Decorator2> [Grand Design] </>stance.
descriptionLabels.ja:
<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>で<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構えを取る。敵の攻撃を受ける直前に発動すると、<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>後方へ瞬間移動して攻撃を回避</>し、<dtv id="X566"/>本の<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【浮遊飛剣】</>を召喚して反撃する。
<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>を押し続けると<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構えを維持できる。<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構え中は、殺気が徐々に消費され続ける。
<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構え中に攻撃を受けると、残りの殺気をすべて消費してその攻撃のダメージを無効化し、後方へ回避する。同時に<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構えが解除される。
<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>を発動しても、進行中の連撃を中断しない。
<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構え中に<InputAction id="LightAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>を押すと、一定量の殺気を消費して<dtv id="X564"/>丁の<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>幻の火縄銃</>を召喚し、敵を攻撃する。<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>【布陣】</>の構え1回につき、1度だけ発動できる。
descriptionLabels.ko:
<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>+<InputAction id="HeavyAttack" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="5"/>를 누르면 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>설계</>】 상태를 취한다. 공격을 받기 직전에 사용하면 모습을 감추며 뒤로 <Character_Yellow_Decorator2>순간이동</>하고, 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>부유 비검</>】 <dtv id="X566"/>자루를 소환해 반격한다.
<InputAction id="Stance" height="26" RightPadding="5" LeftPadding="0"/>을 길게 누르면 【<Character_Yellow_Decorator2>설계</>】 상태를 유지할 수 있으며, 상태를 유지하는 동안 살기가 지속적으로 소모된다.
